title: Social Media Marketing for Accountants, CPAs | Build Your Firm

facts.fact: Build Your Firm says it creates and posts 3 articles and 1 video every month to a firm's LinkedIn and Facebook company pages as part of its social media service.
facts.quote: We create and post 3 articles and 1 video every month to your LinkedIn and Facebook company pages

facts.fact: Build Your Firm's FAQ restates that its program includes posting 3 articles and 1 video each month to keep a firm's Facebook and LinkedIn pages active.
facts.quote: Our program includes posting 3 articles and 1 video each month to keep your Facebook and LinkedIn pages active and professional.

facts.fact: Build Your Firm offers a free white paper titled 'How Accounting Firms Get Found in Google and AI Search'.
facts.quote: Free White Paper: How Accounting Firms Get Found in Google and AI Search

facts.fact: Build Your Firm offers a free information kit linked from the social media page.
Build Your Firm describes social media management as part of its broader Content Marketing in a Box program for accountants and CPA firms.
facts.quote: social media management is part of our broader Content Marketing in a Box program designed specifically for accountants and CPA firms.
